description: US freight broker authority check (FMCSA). Is this broker real and allowed to arrange freight? Live FMCSA record by MC/docket number with broker-authority status and plain flags. The check a carrier or factoring agent runs before accepting a load from an unknown broker. $0.1 USDC on Base. Returns the x402 URL to GET (402 → PAYMENT-SIGNATURE → delivery). Free to call this tool; payment happens on the URL.
name: check_broker_authority
title: US freight broker authority check (FMCSA)
